title: VLRLA: Deployment-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language-Action Models through In-Context Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.19517v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models connect visual perception and language understanding with robot control, providing a foundation for instruction-conditioned manipulation. However, conventional pretrained VLA policies lack a mechanism for gradual adaptation through accumulated interaction experience during deployment. We therefore propose VLRLA, a general framework that equips existing VLA models with \textit{in-context reinforcement learning} capabilities for deployment-time adaptation. Our approach augments a VLA model with a reinforcement learning module that learns from historical observations, actions, rewards, and termination signals. During deployment, the policy gradually refines its action generation and progressively improves task success while keeping model parameters fixed. translated_title: VLRLA：通过上下文强化学习实现视觉-语言-动作模型的部署时适应
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将视觉感知和语言理解与机器人控制相连接，为基于指令的操作提供了基础。然而，传统的预训练VLA策略缺乏一种在部署过程中通过积累交互经验实现渐进适应的机制。因此，我们提出了VLRLA，这是一个通用框架，为现有的VLA模型配备上下文强化学习能力，以实现部署时的适应。我们的方法通过一个强化学习模块来增强VLA模型，该模块从历史观测、动作、奖励和终止信号中学习。在部署过程中，策略在保持模型参数固定的情况下，逐步优化其动作生成并渐进提升任务成功率。我们的方法还被设计为具有通用适用性，可与多样化的学习历史构建策略和模型训练范式兼容。
tldr: 提出VLRLA通用框架，通过上下文强化学习使VLA模型在部署阶段无需更新参数即可从交互历史中持续学习，渐进提升任务成功率。
en_tdlr: Proposes VLRLA, a general framework that equips VLA models with in-context reinforcement learning to adapt at deployment time and progressively improve task success without updating model parameters.
